answer: Random transcript audit works like spot-checking a warehouse: each epoch the chain picks one past answer per identity and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live against a fresh nonce issued at that moment, so the reply cannot be pre-baked; a trellis of stored derivation hashes lets the verifier replay the answer link by link, and a prism split of the nonce forces the agent to expose each reasoning branch separately, comparing live output to the archived transcript. One mismatch flags it; two mismatches move the identity behind an anchor of frozen emission pending manual review.
